intro: Sentinel Aynasha is an operative of the night elven Sentinels serving in the wild borders of Darkshore. Tasked with scouting enemy movements and carrying critical intelligence, she regularly faces peril against hostile forces threatening northern Kalimdor.

p: As a scout and archer for the Sentinels, Aynasha is deployed to the dangerous frontiers where night elven lands clash with hostile incursions. Carrying out stealth missions and bearing urgent dispatches across rugged terrain, she relies on her marksmanship and survival instincts to evade enemy patrols and survive deep within contested territory.
